theme_stances.key_argument: Compute scarcity and vast ecosystems are driving market share and pricing power for cloud vendors.
theme_stances.evidence: Compute scarcity has been driving hyperscaler outperformance recently.

theme_stances.key_argument: Collapsing unit prices for tokens may outpace consumption growth, making compute oversupply plausible.
theme_stances.evidence: If unit prices keep collapsing, consumption has to grow extraordinarily fast just to offset it

theme_stances.key_argument: Valuations for hyperscalers and data center equipment are at 2Y lows, offering a buying opportunity.
theme_stances.evidence: We like buying the dip here in both hyperscalers (GSXUHYPR) and data center equipment (GSTMTDAT)

theme_stances.key_argument: Rapid adoption of AI Services portfolio is reducing friction and increasing the amount of work done on the platform.
theme_stances.evidence: consumption of these services generates token revenue in and of itself

theme_stances.key_argument: Falling token prices may outpace volume growth, challenging the bullish demand narrative.
theme_stances.evidence: More demand + lower prices is not automatically bullish if pricing falls faster than consumption grows.

theme_stances.key_argument: Per-token pricing is a temporary phase that is failing as inference moves to local hardware and open-weight models.
theme_stances.evidence: I struggle with per token pricing as a durable end state model.
